blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Chemical Bonding) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 State the Lewis concept of bonding. Explain the formation of the ionic bond in sodium chloride in its light. (4 marks)
(Lewis concept of bonding bayan karein. Is ki roshni mein sodium chloride mein ionic bond ka banna samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chemical bond: woh force jo do ya zyada atoms, molecules ya ions ko jor kar rakhti hai.

Lewis concept: atoms apni bairooni shell mukammal kar ke noble gas jaisi configuration paane ke liye bonds banate hain, aksar valence shell mein octet bana kar. Yeh har qisam ke bond ki saada wazahat deta hai.

Ionic bond: kam ionization energy wale atom se zyada electron affinity wale atom ki taraf electrons ki mukammal muntaqili se banta hai.

NaCl ka banna:
• ₁₁Na (2, 8, 1) apna bairooni electron khota hai: Na → Na⁺ + e⁻. Na⁺ (2, 8) ki configuration qareebi noble gas ₁₀Ne jaisi hai.
• Cl (2, 8, 7) yeh electron leta hai: Cl + e⁻ → Cl⁻. Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8) bhi noble gas jaisi tarteeb rakhta hai.
• Mukhalif charge wale Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ ions NaCl crystal mein mazboot ionic bond se jure rehte hain (Fig. 3.1).

Aisa hi bond group 1 aur 2 ki metals aur group 16 aur 17 ke elements mein mutawaqqa hai.

book_ref.quote: The oppositely charged Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions are held together by strong ionic bond in the crystal of NaCl.

blocks.prompt:
2 Define covalent and dative bonds. Explain the formation of dative bonds in the hydronium ion, carbon monoxide and ozone. (4 marks)
(Covalent aur dative bonds ki definitions likhein. Hydronium ion, carbon monoxide aur ozone mein dative bonds ka banna samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Covalent bond: do atoms ke darmiyan electrons ki baahmi sharing se; har atom ki valence shell mukammal hoti hai. Yeh non-polar (Cl–Cl, H₂, F₂) ya polar (H–Cl, H–Br, H₂O) ho sakta hai.

Dative (coordinate covalent) bond: jab shared electron pair sirf aik bonding atom de.

(i) Hydronium ion: H₂O ke do covalent bonds aur O par do lone pairs hain; proton mein electrons ki kami hai. O aik lone pair H⁺ ko deta hai:
H₂O + H⁺ → H₃O⁺ (Fig. 3.3a)

(ii) Carbon monoxide: O, C ke saath do electrons share kar ke aam double bond banata hai, magar carbon ka octet adhoora rehta hai. O apna aik lone pair C ko deta hai, yun dative bond banta hai (Fig. 3.3b).

(iii) Ozone: O₂ molecule aur aik azad oxygen atom (O) se banta hai. O₂ ka aik O atom apna lone pair azad O ko deta hai. Darmiyani O ke teen bonds (aik taraf double, doosri taraf coordinate) hain aur us par positive charge hai; lene wale O par negative charge (Fig. 3.3c).

book_ref.quote: Let us consider the example of bond formation between H₂O and a proton (H⁺).

blocks.prompt:
3 What is an expanded octet? Explain the expanded octet of sulfur in the sulfate ion and the role of d orbitals in it. (4 marks)
(Expanded octet kya hai? Sulfate ion mein sulfur ke expanded octet aur is mein d orbitals ke kirdar ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Polyatomic ions: aik se zyada qisam ke atoms se bane ions; un ka kul charge formal charge hai. NH₄⁺ ke ilawa aksar negative: CO₃²⁻, SO₄²⁻, NO₃⁻.

Expanded octet: kuch polyatomic ions mein central atom octet rule tor kar apni electron density oonche orbitals tak phailata hai. Misalein: SO₄²⁻, ClO₄⁻, PO₄³⁻.

SO₄²⁻ mein sulfur: Lewis structure mein S ke do double aur do single bonds hain.
Valence electrons = 2 × (double bond electrons) + 2 × (single bond electrons) = 2(4) + 2(2) = 12
Yani S ke 12 electrons hain, octet se 4 zyada.

d orbitals ka kirdar: phailao d orbitals ki shirkat se hota hai jo zaid electrons ko jagah dete hain. Ground state S ke do unpaired 3p electrons hain. Aik 3p electron 3d mein jaane se chaar unpaired (3s² 3p³ 3d¹, SO₂ mein); aik 3s electron bhi barhane se chhe unpaired (3s¹ 3p³ 3d²), jo SO₄²⁻ ke chhe bonds ke liye zaroori haalat hai. Is se S ki mukhtalif oxidation states bhi samajh aati hain.

book_ref.quote: In some polyatomic ions, the central atom violates the octet rule by expanding its electron density to the higher orbitals.

blocks.prompt:
4 Using the chapter's counting method (2 electrons for each single bond and each lone pair), find the number of electrons around the central atom in (i) PCl₅ (five P–Cl bonds) (ii) SF₆ (six S–F bonds) (iii) XeF₄ (four Xe–F bonds and two lone pairs), and state by how many electrons each exceeds the octet. (4 marks)
(Chapter ke tareeqe se (har single bond aur har lone pair ke 2 electrons), (i) PCl₅ (paanch P–Cl bonds) (ii) SF₆ (chhe S–F bonds) (iii) XeF₄ (chaar Xe–F bonds aur do lone pairs) mein central atom ke gird electrons ginein, aur batayein har aik octet se kitne zyada hai.)
blocks.explanation: Central atom ke har bond pair aur har lone pair ke 2 electrons ginein, phir 8 minus karein.

book_ref.quote: The number of valence electrons of the central atom can be calculated as follows,

steps: (i) PCl₅: P ke gird electrons = 5 × 2 = 10; 10 − 8 = 2 zyada.
(ii) SF₆: S ke gird electrons = 6 × 2 = 12; 12 − 8 = 4 zyada.
(iii) XeF₄: Xe ke gird electrons = 2(4) + 2(2) = 8 + 4 = 12; 12 − 8 = 4 zyada.
Teeno central atoms ke expanded octets hain.
blocks.final_answer: PCl₅ mein P: 10 electrons (2 zyada); SF₆ mein S: 12 (4 zyada); XeF₄ mein Xe: 12 (4 zyada).

blocks.prompt:
5 Electronegativities (given): H = 2.1, N = 3.0, O = 3.5, F = 4.0, Mg = 1.2, Li = 1.0. Using the chapter's limits, classify the bonds (i) O–H (ii) N–H (iii) Mg–O (iv) Li–F (v) F–F as pure covalent, polar covalent or ionic. (4 marks)
(Electronegativities (di gayi): H = 2.1, N = 3.0, O = 3.5, F = 4.0, Mg = 1.2, Li = 1.0. Chapter ki hudood se bonds (i) O–H (ii) N–H (iii) Mg–O (iv) Li–F (v) F–F ko pure covalent, polar covalent ya ionic mein taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har farq nikaal kar muqabla karein: 0.4 se kam pure covalent; 0.4 se 1.8 polar covalent; 1.8 se zyada ionic.

book_ref.quote: The following figure graphically depicts the change in the nature of bond with electronegativity difference.

steps: (i) O–H: 3.5 − 2.1 = 1.4, 0.4 aur 1.8 ke darmiyan: polar covalent.
(ii) N–H: 3.0 − 2.1 = 0.9, 0.4 aur 1.8 ke darmiyan: polar covalent.
(iii) Mg–O: 3.5 − 1.2 = 2.3, 1.8 se zyada: ionic.
(iv) Li–F: 4.0 − 1.0 = 3.0, 1.8 se zyada: ionic.
(v) F–F: 4.0 − 4.0 = 0: pure covalent (non-polar).
blocks.final_answer: O–H aur N–H polar covalent; Mg–O aur Li–F ionic; F–F pure covalent.

blocks.prompt:
6 What is a dipole moment? Explain how it helps to decide the shapes of molecules, taking examples of H₂O, SO₂, BeCl₂, BF₃ and CCl₄. (4 marks)
(Dipole moment kya hai? H₂O, SO₂, BeCl₂, BF₃ aur CCl₄ ki misalon se samjhayein ke yeh molecules ki shakal tay karne mein kaise madad deta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Dipole: woh molecule jis ke aik hisse par δ⁺ aur doosre par δ⁻ ho; us ka dipole moment hota hai. HF mein mukhtalif atoms ki wajah se electrons ki taqseem barabar nahi.
Dipole moment bond ya molecule ki polarity ka adadi paimana hai; unit Debye (D). Yeh δ⁺ se δ⁻ ki taraf hota hai (HF mein H → F). Zyada dipole moment, zyada polarity.

Polyatomic molecules: dipole moment banawat par munhasir hai.
• H₂O: dipole moment 1.85 D, H wale sire se O ki taraf. Linear H–O–H ka dipole moment zero hota, is liye paani non-linear (v-shaped) hai.
• SO₂: 1.61 D, paani ke ulat simt mein; yeh angular hai.
• H₂S: non-linear; polar bond moments khatam nahi hote.

Zero dipole moment (symmetrical molecules):
• BeCl₂: linear, 180° par do barabar aur ulat Be–Cl moments khatam ho jaate hain.
• BF₃: trigonal planar aur symmetrical; dipole moment zero.
• CCl₄: chaar polar C–Cl bonds mukammal tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf; moments khatam, is liye CCl₄ non-polar.

Usool: regular geometry mein aik jaise ligands wale molecules ka kul dipole moment zero aur woh non-polar hote hain.

book_ref.quote: For compounds having more than two atoms, the dipole moment depends on the structure of the molecule.

blocks.prompt:
7 State the basic idea and postulates of the VSEPR model. Give the steps used to determine the shape of a molecule, taking CCl₄ as an example. (4 marks)
(VSEPR model ka bunyadi khayal aur postulates bayan karein. CCl₄ ki misaal le kar molecule ki shakal maloom karne ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
VSEPR model (Sidgwick aur Powell, 1940) central atom ke gird electron pairs se molecules ki shakal batata hai. Molecule aisi shakal leta hai jis mein valence electron pairs ki repulsion kam se kam ho; pairs zyada se zyada door rehte hain aur yahi tarteeb geometry tay karti hai.

Postulates:
1. Lone pairs aur bond pairs dono geometry tay karte hain.
2. Electron pairs repulsion se bachne ke liye zyada se zyada door rehte hain.
3. Lone pairs bond pairs se zyada jagah gherte aur unhein dabate hain. Repulsion: lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp.
4. Double bond ke do aur triple bond ke teen pairs ki charge density zyada hai magar unhein aik pair gina jaata hai.
5. Central atom par bahut electronegative atoms bond pairs ki repulsion kam aur lone pair ki repulsion zyada karte hain.

Qadam (CCl₄):
1. Central atom chunein: sab se kam electronegative ya sab se kam atoms wala element (C).
2. Us ke gird saare pairs ginein: C ke 4 bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi.
3. Kul pairs se electron pair geometry: 4 pairs, tetrahedral.
4. Lone pairs chhor kar asal shakal: CCl₄ tetrahedral (109.5°).

book_ref.quote: In order to have the minimal repulsions, the electron pairs arrange themselves at farthest possible distances.

blocks.prompt:
8 Using the VSEPR model, explain the shapes of BeCl₂, BF₃, SnCl₂ and SO₃. (4 marks)
(VSEPR model se BeCl₂, BF₃, SnCl₂ aur SO₃ ki shakalein samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
AB₂ (linear): BeCl₂ mein Be ke do bond pairs hain, koi lone pair nahi. Do pairs repulsion kam karne ke liye 180° par hain, is liye BeCl₂ linear (Fig. 3.9).

AB₃ (trigonal planar): teen pairs 120° par zyada se zyada door. BF₃ ke teen bond pairs; trigonal planar, har F–B–F angle 120° (Fig. 3.10). Group 3 hydrides AlH₃, GaH₃, BH₃ bhi aise hain.

Lone pair wala AB₃: SnCl₂ mein Sn ke 4 bairooni electrons; do Cl se bonds aur do electrons lone pair. Lone pair tikon ka aik kona gherta hai (vapour phase mein bigri hui trigonal geometry), is liye SnCl₂ v-shaped, angle 120° se kam (Fig. 3.11).

Multiple bonds wala AB₃: SO₃ mein teeno jagahein S=O bonds (har aik aik pair), is liye SO₃ bilkul trigonal, angles 120° (Fig. 3.12).

book_ref.quote: In AB₃ type molecules, the central atom is surrounded by three electron pairs

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain, with the VSEPR model, why the bond angles decrease in the order CH₄ (109.5°) > NH₃ (107°) > H₂O (104.5°). Why is the angle of NF₃ even smaller (102.5°)? (4 marks)
(VSEPR model se samjhayein ke bond angles CH₄ (109.5°) > NH₃ (107°) > H₂O (104.5°) ki tarteeb mein kyun ghatte hain. NF₃ ka angle (102.5°) aur bhi chhota kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Chaaron AB₄ systems hain: central atom ke gird chaar pairs, electron pair geometry tetrahedral.

• CH₄: chaar bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi. Pairs regular tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf; har H–C–H angle 109.5°. SiH₄, GeH₄, CCl₄ bhi aise hain.
• NH₃: teen bond pairs aur aik lone pair. Lone pair zyada jagah gher kar bond pairs ko zyada dafa karta hai (lp-bp > bp-bp), angle 107°; shakal triangular pyramidal.
• H₂O: do bond pairs aur do lone pairs. lp-lp repulsion sab se zyada, angle 104.5°; shakal angular (v-shaped).

Yani jitne zyada lone pairs, utna zyada angle dabta hai.

NF₃ (102.5°): (i) bahut polar N–F bonds ki wajah se N lone pair ko apne nucleus ke qareeb kheenchta hai, jo bonding electrons ko zyada dafa karta hai; (ii) N–F bond pairs F ke qareeb hain; faasla barhne se un ki repulsion kamzor hoti hai aur bonds qareeb aa jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: In this type of molecules, the charge clouds due to four electron pairs avoid their electrostatic repulsions

header: Bond pairs / lone pairs; shakal; angle

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain, with the VSEPR model, how lone pairs change the shapes of AB₅ and AB₆ systems, taking the tri-iodide ion and XeF₄ as examples. (4 marks)
(VSEPR model se samjhayein ke lone pairs AB₅ aur AB₆ systems ki shakal kaise badalte hain; tri-iodide ion aur XeF₄ ki misalein lein.)
blocks.explanation:
AB₅ (trigonal bipyramid): paanch pairs trigonal bipyramid ke konon par: teen planar tikon mein aur do us ke amoodi axis par. Lone pair na ho (PCl₅) to plane mein angles 120° aur axial-planar 90°.

Tri-iodide ion [I₃]⁻: darmiyani I ke paanch pairs: do bond pairs aur teen lone pairs, is liye geometry trigonal bipyramidal. Lone pairs trigonal hisse ke konon par aur do I atoms apices par, aik plane ke upar aur aik neeche. Lone pairs chhor kar I₃⁻ linear hai, I atoms 180° door (Fig. 3.18). Yahan tabdeeli AB₃ aur AB₄ se zyada numayan hai.

AB₆ (octahedral): chhe pairs: chaar planar square ke konon par aur do amoodi axis par; saare angles 90°, maslan SF₆.

XeF₄: chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs. Do lone pairs sab se door, 180° par (axis par). Inhein chhor kar XeF₄ square planar hai, saare F–Xe–F angles 90° (Fig. 3.20).

book_ref.quote: Just as in the AB₃ and AB₄ types, the presence of lone pairs in AB₅ system also changes the shape

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Table 3.1 mein I₃⁻ ko PCl₅ ke saath (koi lone pair nahi) likha gaya hai, jo ghalat hai. Durust: I₃⁻ ke 5 pairs mein 3 lone pairs hain, geometry trigonal bipyramidal magar shakal linear.

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the application of the VSEPR model in drug designing, with the example of aspirin. (4 marks)
(Drug designing mein VSEPR model ke istemal ko aspirin ki misaal se bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Drugs: kimiyai cheezein jo bimari se bachati, tashkhees ya ilaaj karti hain. Yeh jism ke khaas maqamaat ya amal (targets ya substrates: enzymes, proteins, nucleic acids, cellular pathways jaise receptors) par apne bioactive molecules, yani ligands, ke zariye amal karti hain. Receptor aksar protein hai jo binding se ligand ko qubool karta aur jawab deta hai. Har drug khaas target se mukhtalif darje tak amal karti hai: specificity.

Shakal ka kirdar: molecular shakal tay karti hai ke drug target se kaise amal kare. Sirf munasib shakal wale ligands active site mein fit hote hain, jaise khaas chabi khaas taale mein (drug A jurti hai; ghalat shakal wali drug B nahi). VSEPR model biological systems ki shakalein maloom karne mein istemal hota hai: substrate recognition, ligand specificity ya selectivity, antibody recognition.

Aspirin: analgesic (dard kush). Yeh enzyme COX (cyclooxygenase) ki active site se acetyl group (–OCCH₃) ke zariye jurti hai. Dono ki shakalein mutabiq hain, is liye binding kamyab hoti hai aur COX, jo dard ki wajah hai, ruk jaata hai (Fig. 3.21).

book_ref.quote: VSEPR model is successfully applied in determining the shapes of various biological systems

blocks.prompt:
12 State the postulates of valence bond theory. Describe the types of overlap that form sigma bonds, with one example of each. (4 marks)
(Valence bond theory ke postulates bayan karein. Sigma bonds banane wale overlaps ki qismein, har aik ki misaal ke saath, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
VSEPR shakal batata hai magar bond banne ki wajah nahi; VBT dono batati hai aur molecule ko atoms ka majmooa samajhti hai.

Postulates:
1. Covalent bond tab banta hai jab do atoms ke milti energy wale aadhe bhare valence orbitals overlap karein.
2. Zyada overlap, mazboot bond.
3. Covalent bonds simt rakhte hain; simt orbitals ki shakal aur overlap ke tareeqe se tay hoti hai.

Sigma (σ) bond: qareebi atoms ke aadhe bhare orbitals ka nuclear axis par seedha (head-on) overlap. s aur p dono orbitals bana sakte hain.
• s-s overlap: H₂. Har H ka aadha bhara s orbital; overlap ke baad electrons jora bana lete hain aur density dono nuclei ke gird yaksan (Fig. 3.22).
• s-p overlap: HCl. H ka s orbital Cl ke p orbital se milta hai; density Cl (zyada electronegative) ke qareeb zyada, is liye HCl polar (Fig. 3.23).
• p-p overlap: Cl₂. Do Cl atoms ke p orbitals nuclear axis par milte hain; electronegativity barabar hone se density yaksan (Fig. 3.24).

book_ref.quote: The postulates of VBT are given below

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain the formation of the double bond in the oxygen molecule according to VBT. How is the bent H₂S molecule formed, and why is its angle smaller than that of water? (4 marks)
(VBT ke mutabiq oxygen molecule mein double bond ka banna samjhayein. Bent H₂S molecule kaise banta hai, aur is ka angle paani se chhota kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
O₂ mein double bond (O=O): har O atom ke amoodi p orbitals (px aur py) mein do unpaired electrons.
• Dono atoms ke px orbitals seedhe (end-to-end) milte hain: σ bond.
• py orbitals aapas mein mutawazi hain; yeh pehlu se milte hain, do lobes nuclei ke plane ke upar aur do neeche: π bond (Fig. 3.26).
Yun O atoms aik σ aur aik π bond se double bonded hain.

H₂S: S ke do aadhe bhare 3p orbitals (3py aur 3pz) hain. Har aik aik H ke 1s se milta hai: do σ bonds. Molecule non-linear (v-shaped), angle 92° (Fig. 3.25).

Muqabla: H–O–H angle 104.5° magar H–S–H 92°, kyun ke S ke orbitals bare hain aur lone pair zyada repulsion karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The px orbitals on the two oxygen atoms are oriented in such a way that they overlap end-to-end linearly.

blocks.prompt:
14 Define hybridization and give its main features. Explain sp³ hybridization taking methane as an example. (4 marks)
(Hybridization ki definition aur ahem khoobiyan likhein. Methane ki misaal se sp³ hybridization samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hybridization: thori mukhtalif energy aur shakal wale atomic orbitals ka mil kar barabar energy aur shakal wale naye orbitals ka set banana.

Khoobiyan:
• Yeh aik hi atom (ya ion) ke orbitals ka milaap hai.
• Sirf qareebi energy wale orbitals milte hain.
• Milne wale orbitals ki tadaad bante hybrid orbitals ke barabar.

sp³ hybridization: aik s (kam energy, golai wala) aur teen p (zyada energy, dumbbell) orbitals mil kar chaar barabar sp³ orbitals dete hain jo tetrahedral hain.
Carbon: ground state ₆C 2s² 2px¹ 2py¹; excited state 2s¹ 2px¹ 2py¹ 2pz¹; yeh chaar orbitals mil kar chaar aadhe bhare sp³ orbitals (Fig. 3.27). Har sp³ orbital ke do lobes, aik bara aur aik chhota.

Methane: C ke chaar sp³ orbitals chaar H atoms ke 1s se alag alag milte hain, chaar sp³-s σ bonds jo regular tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain, H–C–H = 109.5°.

book_ref.quote: Hybridization is a process of mixing of orbitals in a single atom (or ion).

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain sp² hybridization in BF₃ and sp hybridization in BeCl₂. Compare sp, sp² and sp³ hybridization. (4 marks)
(BF₃ mein sp² aur BeCl₂ mein sp hybridization samjhayein. sp, sp² aur sp³ hybridization ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
sp² (BF₃): ₅B ground state 2s² 2px¹; excited 2s¹ 2px¹ 2py¹. Aik s aur do p orbitals mil kar teen aadhe bhare sp² orbitals, trigonal plane mein 120° par. Har aik F ke aadhe bhare 2pz se milta hai, is liye BF₃ triangular planar, F–B–F = 120° (Fig. 3.30).

sp (BeCl₂): ₄Be ground state 2s²; excited 2s¹ 2px¹. Aik s aur aik p orbital mil kar do barabar sp orbitals, linear 180° par. Har aik Cl ke aadhe bhare p orbital se milta hai, is liye BeCl₂ linear (Fig. 3.32).

book_ref.quote: In sp hybridization, one s (low energy and spherical) and one p orbital

blocks.prompt:
16 State the postulates of molecular orbital theory. Describe the formation of molecular orbitals by s-s overlap in H₂ and by head-on and sideways approach of p orbitals. (4 marks)
(Molecular orbital theory ke postulates bayan karein. H₂ mein s-s overlap aur p orbitals ki head-on aur sideways approach se molecular orbitals ka banna bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Postulates:
1. Milne wale atoms ke atomic orbitals overlap kar ke naye molecular orbitals banate hain jo poore molecule ke hote hain.
2. Overlap wave function ke munasib sign wale lobes se hota hai (p orbital ka aik lobe '+', doosra '−').
3. Do atomic orbitals se do molecular orbitals: aik jaise sign se kam energy wala bonding MO (σ ya π); mukhalif sign se parent orbitals se zyada energy wala anti-bonding MO (σ* ya π*).
4. Bond order = (a − b)/2, a = bonding aur b = anti-bonding electrons.

s-s overlap (H₂): do 1s orbitals se do MOs. Bonding MO nuclear axis ke gird yaksan; anti-bonding MO ki density nuclei se door (Fig. 3.34).

Head-on approach: p orbitals aik hi axis (x-axis) par aate hain: σ(2px) bonding aur σ*(2px) anti-bonding MOs.

Sideways approach: mutawazi axes wale py ya pz orbitals se π MOs. Bonding π(2py), π(2pz) ki nuclear axis par density zero (nodal plane); anti-bonding π*(2py), π*(2pz) ki nuclei ke darmiyan density sab se kam (Fig. 3.35).

book_ref.quote: The atomic orbitals overlap with the lobe having suitable sign of the wave function of the orbital.

blocks.prompt:
17 With the help of molecular orbital theory, explain why He₂ does not exist while N₂ has a triple bond. (4 marks)
(Molecular orbital theory ki madad se samjhayein ke He₂ kyun nahi banta jab ke N₂ mein triple bond hai.)
blocks.explanation:
He₂: He 1s² hai. Do He atoms ke 1s orbitals mil kar bonding σ1s aur anti-bonding σ*1s MOs dete hain (Fig. 3.36). Chaar electrons mein se do σ1s aur do σ*1s mein.
He₂ ka bond order = (2 − 2)/2 = 0
Zero bond order ka matlab koi bond nahi, is liye He₂ nahi banta.

N₂: ₇N 1s², 2s², 2px¹, 2py¹, 2pz¹ hai. 2s orbitals se σ2s aur σ*2s; 2p orbitals se chhe MOs. Energy ki barhti tarteeb:
σ2s < σ*2s < π2py = π2pz < σ2px < π*2py = π*2pz < σ*2px
Chhe 2p electrons π2py, π2pz aur σ2px mein; koi 2p anti-bonding orbital nahi bharta (Fig. 3.37).
N₂ ka bond order = (6 − 0)/2 = 3
Yani N atoms teen bonds se jure hain, aik σ aur do π: triple bond.

book_ref.quote: For a successful formation of He₂ molecule, 1s orbitals of two He atoms must combine

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the molecular orbital picture of the oxygen molecule. How does MOT explain its bond order and its paramagnetic nature? (4 marks)
(Oxygen molecule ki molecular orbital tasveer bayan karein. MOT is ke bond order aur paramagnetic fitrat ki wazahat kaise karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
O₂ ke MOs ki energy tarteeb (Fig. 3.38):
σ2s < σ*2s < σ2px < π2py = π2pz < π*2py = π*2pz < σ*2px

2p electrons ki bharai: chhe bonding σ2px, π2py, π2pz mein aur do anti-bonding π* mein, aik π*(2py) aur aik π*(2pz) mein (unpaired).

Bond order = (6 − 2)/2 = 2, yani aik σ aur aik π bond: double bond (O=O).

Paramagnetism: paramagnetic cheezein magnetic field ki taraf khinchti hain aur un mein aik ya zyada unpaired electrons hote hain; zyada unpaired electrons se bahut paramagnetic. π*(2py) aur π*(2pz) ke do unpaired electrons O₂ ko apna magnetic field dete hain jo bairooni field se amal karta hai. Is liye O₂ paramagnetic hai: liquid oxygen taaqatwar magnet ke poles ke darmiyan khinch kar latak jaati hai. MOT is rawayye ki kamyab wazahat karti hai.

19 Using bond order = (a − b)/2, find the bond order of diatomic species having (i) 8 bonding and 2 anti-bonding electrons (ii) 8 bonding and 4 anti-bonding electrons (iii) 6 bonding and 4 anti-bonding electrons (iv) 4 bonding and 4 anti-bonding electrons. Arrange them in order of decreasing bond order and say which cannot exist. (4 marks)
(Bond order = (a − b)/2 se un diatomic species ka bond order nikalein jin mein (i) 8 bonding aur 2 anti-bonding (ii) 8 bonding aur 4 anti-bonding (iii) 6 bonding aur 4 anti-bonding (iv) 4 bonding aur 4 anti-bonding electrons hon. Inhein ghatte bond order ki tarteeb mein likhein aur batayein kaunsi wujood nahi rakh sakti.)
blocks.explanation: Har aik ke liye a aur b formula mein rakhein; zero bond order ka matlab koi bond nahi.

book_ref.quote: and is taken as half of the difference between the number of bonding electrons (say a) and anti-bonding electrons (say b)

steps: (i) (8 − 2)/2 = 3 (triple bond).
(ii) (8 − 4)/2 = 2 (double bond).
(iii) (6 − 4)/2 = 1 (single bond).
(iv) (4 − 4)/2 = 0 (koi bond nahi).
Tarteeb: (i) 3 > (ii) 2 > (iii) 1 > (iv) 0; species (iv) He₂ ki tarah wujood nahi rakh sakti.

blocks.prompt:
20 What are intermolecular forces? Name their types and explain how they differ from chemical bonds in nature and strength. (4 marks)
(Intermolecular forces kya hain? In ki qismein batayein aur samjhayein ke yeh fitrat aur mazbooti mein chemical bonds se kaise mukhtalif hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Intermolecular (van der Waals) forces: chemical bonds ki tarah jorne wali forces, magar molecules ki kashish bahut kamzor. Yeh har qisam ke atoms aur molecules mein hoti hain jab woh kaafi qareeb hon, molecules ko qareeb laati hain aur gas, liquid, solid haalaton mein khaas physical properties deti hain.

Qismein:
1. Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole (London dispersion) forces.
2. Permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces.
3. Hydrogen bonding.

Chemical bonds se farq: ionic, covalent aur metallic asal chemical bonds hain; yeh electrons ki muntaqili aur sharing se nayi species banate aur chemical properties par asar daalte hain. Intermolecular forces molecules ko qareeb laati aur physical properties par asar daalti hain. Kamzor hone ki wajah se van der Waals forces ko khalis chemical bonds nahi kaha jata. Asal farq mazbooti ka hai, jo bond energy se naapi jaati hai (Table 3.4).

book_ref.quote: Intermolecular forces are also considered as binding forces just like chemical bonds.

rows: Electrons ki muntaqili aur sharing se nayi species.
Kamzor: hydrogen bonding 20-50, dipole-dipole 5-20, van der Waals 1-20 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
21 Define bond energy. Explain the factors on which it depends, using the data for H–X bonds and carbon-carbon bonds. (4 marks)
(Bond energy ki definition likhein. H–X bonds aur carbon-carbon bonds ke data se is par asar daalne wale awaamil samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bond energy: kisi cheez ke aik mole mein aik qisam ke saare bonds torne ke liye darkaar ausat energy. Yeh reaction ki heat naap kar tajurbe se maloom hoti hai; unit kJ mol⁻¹. Yeh bond ki mazbooti aur reactivity ka paimana hai.

Awaamil: (1) bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq; (2) atoms ka size.

Electronegativity ka farq: H–X (X = F, Cl, Br, I) mein farq barhne se bond energy barhti hai. Zyada farq se zyada polarity, jo atoms ko jorne wali izafi kashish deti hai. Is liye H–F (565) > H–Cl (427) > H–Br (363) > H–I (295) kJ mol⁻¹.

Multiple bonds: multiple bonds ki energy single se zyada: C≡C (839) > C=C (614) > C–C (347) kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: The strength of a bond depends upon the following factors.

blocks.prompt:
22 Using average bond energies from Table 3.2 (C–H 413, H–H 432, N≡N 941, O–H 467 kJ mol⁻¹), calculate the energy needed to break (i) all C–H bonds in 2 mol of CH₄ (ii) all bonds in 2 mol of H₂ (iii) all bonds in 0.5 mol of N₂ (iv) all O–H bonds in 1 mol of H₂O. (4 marks)
(Table 3.2 ki ausat bond energies (C–H 413, H–H 432, N≡N 941, O–H 467 kJ mol⁻¹) se (i) 2 mol CH₄ ke saare C–H bonds (ii) 2 mol H₂ ke saare bonds (iii) 0.5 mol N₂ ke saare bonds (iv) 1 mol H₂O ke saare O–H bonds torne ki energy nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Energy = (bonds ke moles) × (bond energy); bonds ke moles = cheez ke moles × har molecule mein aise bonds.

book_ref.quote: Let us consider the role played by electronegativity difference.

steps: (i) CH₄ mein 4 C–H bonds: 2 × 4 = 8 mol bonds; 8 × 413 = 3304 kJ.
(ii) H₂ mein 1 H–H bond: 2 mol bonds; 2 × 432 = 864 kJ.
(iii) N₂ mein 1 N≡N bond: 0.5 mol bonds; 0.5 × 941 = 470.5 kJ.
(iv) H₂O mein 2 O–H bonds: 2 mol bonds; 2 × 467 = 934 kJ.

blocks.prompt:
23 Covalent radii (given): C = 77 pm, F = 64 pm, Si = 117 pm. (i) Calculate the expected C–F and Si–F bond lengths. (ii) Using the observed values C–F = 135 pm (Table 3.3) and Si–F = 155 pm (in SiF₄), find the shortening in each and its percentage. (iii) Explain the shortening. (4 marks)
(Covalent radii (diye gaye): C = 77 pm, F = 64 pm, Si = 117 pm. (i) Mutawaqqa C–F aur Si–F bond lengths nikalein. (ii) Asal qeematon C–F = 135 pm (Table 3.3) aur Si–F = 155 pm (SiF₄ mein) se har aik mein kami aur us ka percentage nikalein. (iii) Kami ki wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Mutawaqqa bond length = covalent radii ka majmooa; kami = mutawaqqa − asal; percentage = kami/mutawaqqa × 100.

book_ref.quote: The electronegativity difference causes an ionic character in the covalent bond.

steps: (i) C–F mutawaqqa = 77 + 64 = 141 pm; Si–F mutawaqqa = 117 + 64 = 181 pm.
(iii) Electronegativity ka farq covalent bond ko ionic character deta hai; bonded atoms ki izafi kashish bond ko chhota karti hai. Si–F ki zyada kami us ke zyada ionic character ko zahir karti hai.
blocks.final_answer: Mutawaqqa C–F 141 pm, Si–F 181 pm; kami 6 pm (4.3%) aur 26 pm (14.4%), ionic character ki wajah se.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan C ka radius 77 pm sawal mein diya gaya hai; chapter sirf Si = 117 pm aur F = 64 pm deta hai. Usool aik hi hai: jitna zyada electronegativity ka farq, utna zyada ionic character aur utna chhota bond.

blocks.prompt:
24 Define bond length. How is it determined? Explain the effect of atomic size, electronegativity difference and the nature of the bond on bond length, with examples from Table 3.3. (4 marks)
(Bond length ki definition likhein. Yeh kaise maloom hoti hai? Atomic size, electronegativity ke farq aur bond ki qisam ka bond length par asar Table 3.3 ki misalon se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bond length: covalent bond banane wale do atoms ke nuclei ka darmiyani faasla. Yeh electron diffraction, X-ray diffraction ya spectral studies jaise physical tareeqon se maloom hoti hai. Is par electronegativity, size aur bond ki qisam (single, double, triple) asar daalte hain.

Atoms ka size: size barhne se bond length barhti hai. C–F 135 pm < C–Cl 180 pm < C–Br 196 pm < C–I 214 pm; Cl atom F se bahut bara hai.

Electronegativity ka farq: zyada farq bond ko chhota karta hai. SiF₄ mein Si–F taqreeban 155 pm, jab ke radii (Si = 117 pm, F = 64 pm) se 181 pm. Farq ionic character paida karta hai aur izafi kashish bond ko chhota karti hai.

Bond ki qisam: C–C 154 pm > C=C 133 pm > C≡C 120 pm; multiple bonds chhote hain.

book_ref.quote: With an increase in size of the atoms, the covalent bond length also increases.

blocks.prompt:
25 Compare ionic, covalent and metallic bonds and intermolecular forces in terms of their bond energies. Why is the metallic bond weaker than ionic and covalent bonds? (4 marks)
(Ionic, covalent, metallic bonds aur intermolecular forces ka bond energies ke lihaaz se muqabla karein. Metallic bond ionic aur covalent bonds se kamzor kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ionic, covalent aur metallic asal chemical bonds hain; yeh electrons ki muntaqili aur sharing se nayi species banate aur chemical properties par asar daalte hain, jab ke intermolecular forces molecules ko qareeb laati aur physical properties par asar daalti hain. Asal farq mazbooti ka hai, jo bond energy se naapi jaati hai.

Table 3.4 se: NaCl ka ionic bond (760 kJ mol⁻¹) sab se mazboot, phir paani ka covalent O–H bond (464), hydrogen bonding (20-50), permanent dipole-dipole forces (5-20) aur van der Waals forces (1-20). Yani ionic bond sab se mazboot hai aur chemical bonds intermolecular forces se bahut mazboot hain.

Metallic bond: zyada tar electrostatic forces se samjhaya jaata hai, agarche kuch theories covalent fitrat batati hain. Is ki ausat bond energy 100-150 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, ionic aur covalent dono se kamzor. Is kam mazbooti ki tasalli bakhsh wajah metallic crystal mein electrons ka wasee phailao (delocalization) hai.

book_ref.quote: The metallic bond is mostly elaborated in terms of electrostatic forces
